features.name: halogen_burden_score
features.description: Total burden across descriptors associated with halogen atoms or halogen-specific substructures.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns several sparse counts into a split-ready cumulative alert for heavy substitution patterns.

features.name: rare_motif_count
features.description: Count of uncommon binary or count alerts among low-frequency substructure descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates very sparse indicators so a tree can split on presence of any unusual motif.
features.formula: np.where(V4 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V19 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V20 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V21 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V24 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V29 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V40 > 0, 1, 0)

features.name: halogenated_aromatic_alert
features.description: Indicator for simultaneous halogen-related signal and aromatic or carbon-substructure signal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Makes a non-linear co-occurrence available as a single branch condition.

features.name: heteroatom_functional_burden
features.description: Sum of oxygen, nitrogen, donor, and functional-group count descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures cumulative polar or reactive functionality without assuming a linear effect.

features.name: oxygen_nitrogen_balance_ratio
features.description: Smoothed ratio contrasting oxygen and donor-related descriptors with nitrogen and nitro descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a thresholdable balance feature when different heteroatom families have opposing behavior.

features.name: carbon_rich_low_polar_flag
features.description: Indicator for high carbon percentage with very low oxygen, donor, and nitrogen counts.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes a hydrophobic low-polarity region using one split.

features.name: size_topology_score
features.description: Log-scaled size and topology score combining large-range topology descriptors with molecular shape descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses heavy-tailed geometry signals into a stable ordered feature.

features.name: large_compact_molecule_flag
features.description: Indicator for jointly high values of global size, compactness, and topological descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures a high-bulk interaction that trees might otherwise need several levels to isolate.

features.name: electronic_extreme_flag
features.description: Indicator for extreme charge or electrotopological descriptor values relative to central training-fold ranges.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives a simple split for unusual electronic profiles at either tail.

features.name: descriptor_tail_count
features.description: Count of selected descriptors lying in high training-fold tails using unsupervised thresholds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes broad descriptor extremeness, useful for isolating atypical compounds.

features.name: semantic_structural_recalcitrance_band
features.description: Ordinal expert or LLM judgment from row values only: 0 minimal persistent-structure cues; 1 mild; 2 elevated; 3 strong, considering aromaticity, halogenation, nitro-like alerts, ring or branching complexity, and bulky topology.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a compact chemistry-informed grouping when multiple alerts co-occur.

features.name: semantic_polar_accessibility_band
features.description: Ordinal expert or LLM judgment from row values only: 0 very low polar accessibility; 1 low; 2 moderate; 3 high, considering heteroatom counts, donor signal, oxygen and nitrogen balance, and whether size or carbon richness may bury polar functionality.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a qualitative separability cue for trees around functional accessibility rather than raw counts alone.
